name: huddol-workspace
description: Run your own organization of agents.

scripts.check: pnpm check:web && pnpm check:core && pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:core: node scripts/core.mjs ruff check . && node scripts/core.mjs ruff format --check . && node scripts/core.mjs mypy src/huddol && node scripts/core.mjs lint-imports
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && node scripts/cargo.mjs check && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check:web: pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm exec biome format --write . && node scripts/core.mjs ruff format . && cargo fmt --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome lint . && node scripts/core.mjs ruff check . && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:core && pnpm test:rust
